reviews.text: The overall style is really cool and the gameplay is super fluid. It does a great job of keeping you hooked and everything feels very responsive. It's the perfect game to just jump into, chill out, and completely zone out for a couple of hours. Definitely a great experience.

Не рекомендую — Переусложнённый и хаотичный симулятор боли Если вы ищете приятный платформер, чтобы расслабиться после рабочего дня или учёбы, держитесь от этой игры подальше. Вместо честного вызова PixelBoss: Shattered Depth предлагает искусственную сложность и тонну фрустрации.
A 2D game with Sega or Dendy graphics. Another treasure hunt and monster battle. At least it's not expensive, but still, so-so.
The controls are very unresponsive, as for a platformer, with constant under-jumping and over-jumping, and it's hard to even count the number of times you hit spikes and other traps because of this
For me, the main problem with this game is the graphics. Some objects look gothic and some look like they came from a cartoon. Plus the controls are pretty strange, especially when jumping

PixelBoss: Shattered Depths is a hardcore 2D pixel art platformer where every mistake counts. Fight, avoid traps, and navigate levels that require precision, reflexes, and patience. This game promises all of that. But it turns out to be another frustrating platformer! I'm very disappointed :(

I bought a crude and flawed product. The controls are terrible, the jumps are unresponsive, and you die not because of the difficulty, but because of the bugs. It's impossible to complete without stress, and it's not fun. Totally disappointed.

Good game! The pixel art graphics look nostalgic and very cozy. The gameplay is exciting — boss fights require tactics and attention, and the levels are well-designed, which does not let you get bored. I was especially pleased with the diverse arsenal and the opportunity to improve the character.
Boring and annoying. Too difficult without any reward. Gets boring to die 100 times. Not recommended
I was hooked on this game at first sight. I felt nostalgic for the days of the dendy and sega. The game is great. The gameplay is good. I recommend. The game is worth the money.

I actually liked the game, but I can't give it a high rating because it's still a bit rough around the edges. This game has strange graphics, and sometimes the sprites differ from one another. At times, the controls are very awkward and sluggish. I think the game has potential, but it hasn't fully realized it yet. If the game ends up being much better than it is now, I’m sure I’ll come back and change my rating.
Tight controls, punishing but fair platforming. Pixel art is gorgeous, combat feels crisp. A true hardcore gem. Highly recommend!

An excellent hardcore platformer! Skillful controls, varied enemies and bosses, and deadly traps force you to learn from every mistake. Atmospheric pixel art and a dynamic soundtrack immerse you in the dark dungeons. A true challenge for old-school fans!

I thought it would be boring, but I ended up totally hooked for the whole evening. The graphics are cool and the combat is awesome. I recommend it to everyone. I have absolutely no regrets and will definitely play it again because I enjoyed it so much
A brutal test of reflexes and composure. One wrong move and you are back at the start. It demands absolute focus and rewards pure skill.
Gorgeous pixel art hides a world of unforgiving platforming. Every jump must be perfect. The tension is incredible.
The controls are razor sharp. You always feel in command of your character, which makes every death feel like your own fault, not the game's.
This is a game about staying calm. When the spikes start moving and the platforms crumble, you have to stay composed or you will panic and fall.
Success here feels earned. When you finally land that impossible jump or defeat a brutal boss, you know it was all you.
Tiny pixel hero. Huge anger issues. Mostly mine. The levels demand precision but when you finally clear a section, the dopamine hit lands harder than a freight train. Recommended.

At first, I didn't think I'd like it, but then I ended up playing until late at night. The world is interesting, everything is well-crafted, the gameplay is enjoyable, and I’ll definitely be coming back.
The dark, underground world is full of secrets and deadly traps. Exploring is risky, but finding a new path feels amazing.
It's an extremely controversial game, with both advantages and disadvantages, but the latter outweighs the former.
For that kind of money, is it still in early access? It's not 100% worth it.
A series of deadly obstacles that force you to master your own movements and reactions.
i beat it in ten minutes this game is way too short
The enemies are not just damage sponges. Each one has a unique behavior that you must learn to overcome with timing and precision.
It's a very difficult game in some aspects, but if you want to torture yourself, go ahead and buy it.
Success here seems absolutely normal. When you finally make an impossible jump or defeat a brutal boss, you know it's all thanks to you and the experience of the game.
Hardcore 2D pixel platformer. Precise jumps, combat, deadly traps, and bosses. One mistake = restart. For Celeste/SMB fans. 8/10.
I love hardcore platformers. There are bosses and levels with traps. I died about 50 times, but every time I wanted to finish the game. For those who like challenges, this game is perfect.
A hard but interesting platformer. The levels are cool, and the bosses are challenging. For hardcore fans
Хардкорный платформер без сюсюканья: прыжок не туда и ты снова в начале. Если любишь проверку реакции, точности и нервов, игра зайдёт‍
Every single jump matters. The level design is tight and leaves no room for error, which makes clearing a tough section feel legendary.
uh huh
